versions.changelog:
- Added support for direct human payment links: agents can now generate payment URLs for users to complete eSIM or top-up purchases from their own wallets.
- Increased travel eSIM coverage to 200+ destinations.
- Updated documentation to describe the link-based payment flow and referral rewards.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
Published with GitHub source provenance attached. Travel eSIMs across 197 destinations alongside airtime in 150+ countries.
Travel eSIMs live across 197 destinations, and the skill card restored.

Travel eSIMs are live: 197 destinations, quoted with no recipient, delivered as an LPA string the buyer installs. The skill previously said airtime was the whole product and told agents not to offer eSIMs.

Describes only what is actually for sale. Airtime and data top-ups are live; eSIMs, prepaid bills and international payouts are built but supplier-gated, and GET /v1/catalog is the live answer. Adds the MVNO warning: operator auto-detect is wrong on MVNOs, and a voucher bought for the wrong network delivers, verifies, and cannot be redeemed or refunded.

Initial release of "iomarkets-topup" for mobile top-ups via USDC on Algorand:

- Enables purchasing mobile airtime and data in 150+ countries; delivered to any phone, no account required.
- Supports real-time USDC → local currency quoting, payment via Algorand/x402, signed proof of delivery, and automatic on-chain refunds.
- Clear HTTP API for lookup, quoting, order, and payment status.
- Other services (eSIMs, prepaid bills, payouts) visible in API but not live—reliably gated per /v1/catalog.
- Includes guidance for agentic integration and wallet/payment handling, both hosted and local.
